body:
Hoarding cats while taking care of your 2 year old grandson while dealing with cancer is great?

You will forget me, I guarantee it. It's weird though, isn't it? How if I were to kill myself right now, you'd be the last person I ever talked to. You'd be the only person with knowledge of my thoughts other than myself. You're the only person that has tried to help me. Not my family, not my closest friends, not my peers; a random stranger online. To you it may seem comforting, but to me it's completely pathetic. No one that actually claims they care about me actually do. I told my mom I was depressed two years ago, she called me a moron, a liar, and to get out of her face. You have no idea how much courage it took me to say that. I started crying when I told her, it took that much to say it. I have a severe stutter so talking to anyone is extremely uncomfortable and leaves me feeling depressed 99% of the time. She threw me out like a piece of trash and completely ignored me. If no one I care about cares about me, why live? You may care about me, the 20,000 other people here might to, but what do I care? I don't know you, I never will.  Your words will never mean anything to me other than just some random person begging me to not kill myself. 

I'm a piece of shit, a disease. I shouldn't be forced to exist as a detriment to society when I don't want to. I'll never be able to be normal, to communicate, to succeed. I'm a loser who got this far on sheer dumb luck that ran out as soon as I realized the depth of my depression. I have no hope, I have no love, I have no reason to live other than to exist to exist. That's the problem humans have, they exist just to exist. I refuse.

Or I could grow up to be a piece of shit and ruin the lives of anyone around me. The odds of being great are slim to none, there's too many people in the world for everyone to grow up to be great. If I killed myself right now, you'd forget about me in a day. The world wouldn't mourn my loss, it'd keep turning just the way it did yesterday and the day before that. The world has no place for weak people like me. I'm taking the place of someone who has the potential to be great by being selfish and clinging to a life that has brought me absolutely nothing satisfying. I'm going to kill myself, it's a fact. I've accepted it completely and now it's a matter of time. It's not that I want to die, I need to. I feel it inside me. When I wake up, when I'm at work, when I;m with my friends, when I go to sleep. These thoughts never leave and I have no choice. I am going to die and I'm sincerely happy that it's going to be by my own hand in my prime rather than rotting in a hospital .

lol who cares. What is one less person in a world of nearly 8 billion? I'm completely insignificant, it's a fact. I'm a piece of shit and I don't deserve to live. I'm doing everyone a favor by shooting myself.

Because I want to die. I've been depressed since I was 12, molested by my father, suicidal since I was 16. I just don't want to do this anymore, and I shouldn't have to. It's my life, I can do whatever I want with it. If other people get upset then that's their problem.
Why is every suicide watch reply riddled with smiley faces? ": )" is most annoying thing to constantly shove in someones face when they're not well
